title.zh: 性能：MCP 缓存、手机列表与首屏字体
title.en: Performance: MCP caches, a windowed phone list, and the first-paint font

highlights.zh: MCP：catalogue 改 O(1) 命中（4.12→0.20 ms）、示例每曲风只建一次（2896→4.6 ms）、4 MB manifest 两遍解析改一遍（203→3.2 ms），输出逐字节一致。
highlights.en: MCP: the catalogue is memoised (4.12 to 0.20 ms), examples are built once per genre (2896 to 4.6 ms) and the 4 MB manifest is parsed once, not twice (203 to 3.2 ms), byte-identical.

highlights.zh: 手机选曲列表窗口化（159→24 行）；字体移出首屏关键路径（中位 FCP 3536→2448 ms）；性能装置不再"手机失败却退出 0"。
highlights.en: The phone genre picker windows its rows (159 to 24); the font leaves the critical path (median FCP 3536 to 2448 ms); the perf harness no longer fails the mobile profile and exits 0.

title.zh: WebCodecs 导出与 WAV 性能优化，手机播放修复
title.en: WebCodecs export, faster WAV, and the mobile playback fixes

highlights.zh: 导出新增 WebCodecs（AAC/Opus）通道，WAV 走三层性能优化；MP3 编码改在 worker 里跑，占用与内存更小。
highlights.en: Export gains a WebCodecs (AAC/Opus) path and a three-tier WAV optimisation, and MP3 encoding moves into a worker with a smaller footprint.

highlights.zh: 手机端修好双路同时发声、切轨残留串音与动画不同步——播放条、全屏播放器与片段播放器现在只有一路在响。
highlights.en: The phone shell no longer plays two transports at once: switching tracks stops the previous sound, the animations stay in step, and the bar, full player and clip player agree on who owns the audio.

title.zh: 桌面端能用片段试听的都改走预生成 MP3
title.en: Desktop auditions that can use a pre-cut clip now do

highlights.zh: 曲风详情的整曲试听、对比的单边试听、两条时间轴的试听都播放预生成 MP3；鼓试听、同步 A/B 合成与即兴仍用实时引擎（它们没有对应片段）。
highlights.en: The genre page's full audition, the compare view's single-genre audition and both timelines play the pre-cut MP3, while drums, the synchronous A/B composite and jam keep the live engine, which is the only thing that can make those sounds.

highlights.zh: 每套皮肤的封面随发布投放上线（不随仓库分发，避免每次推送搬动数百 MB）。
highlights.en: Every skin's artwork ships with the deploy rather than in the repository, so each push no longer carries hundreds of megabytes.

title.zh: 手机版除即兴和探索外，都播放预生成片段
title.en: Every phone module but jam and explore now plays the rendered clip

highlights.zh: 手机壳的播放条、挑战屏播放键与全屏播放器一律播放该曲风的预生成 MP3；即兴与探索仍用实时引擎（要听/改参数）。
highlights.en: The phone shell's bar, the challenge transport and the full-screen player all play the genre's pre-cut MP3, while jam and explore keep the live engine they exist to hear.

title.zh: 手机壳里的设置与手册面板又在了
title.en: The phone shell's settings and manual panels are back

highlights.zh: 手机壳的四个面板此前被放在两个分支各写一份；去重时误删了设置与手册两个，现已恢复为两个分支共用一个定义。
highlights.en: The shell's four panels used to be written once per branch; the dedup deleted the settings and manual ones, and both now render from one shared definition.

highlights.zh: 同时修正了验证口径：判断面板是否打开要看 [role=dialog]，而不是整页节点数（换了屏会让节点数持平）。
highlights.en: The verification metric was fixed too: a panel is open when [role=dialog] appears, not when the page's node count grows — a screen swap can keep it flat.

title.zh: 手机壳里点不动的入口全修好了
title.en: The phone shell's dead entries all work now

highlights.zh: 手机壳此前只收到三个属性：播放条打不开全屏播放器，更多里的设置/更新/手册/搜索四个入口点了没反应。现已接通整组属性。
highlights.en: The shell had been given only three props, so the bar could not open the full player and four entries under More did nothing; the whole contract is wired now.

highlights.zh: 首页搜索以前只管列表与计数、时间轴不动；现在时间轴也随搜索变短（159→17 时节点 11→4）。
highlights.en: Search used to narrow the list and its count while the timeline ignored it; the timeline shrinks too now (11 nodes to 4 when 159 genres become 17).

title.zh: 手机打开任何桌面地址都会进入 /m
title.en: A phone opening any desktop address lands in /m

highlights.zh: 以前只有 / 会被接管，手机从分享链接、书签或后退键进来仍停在桌面版；现在除 /m 外一律进入手机外壳。
highlights.en: Only the root used to be taken over, so a phone arriving from a share link, a bookmark or the back button stayed in the desktop layout; now every address except /m enters the phone shell.

highlights.zh: 并在跳转前一帧不渲染桌面界面，避免手机先看到用不了的布局；?desktop=1 可显式留在桌面版。
highlights.en: The desktop surface is not painted for the frame before the redirect, and ?desktop=1 keeps a phone on the desktop page on purpose.

title.zh: 全部 159 个曲风都有片段，渲染加了进程级看门狗
title.en: All 159 genres have a clip, and the renderer got a process-level watchdog

highlights.zh: 最后 4 个曲风补切完成（goa/vocal/euro/dream-trance，各 16.6 秒）⇒ 清单 159 条，159 个曲风一个不缺。
highlights.en: The last four genres are cut (goa, vocal, euro and dream trance, 16.6 s each), so the list holds 159 clips and no genre is missing.

highlights.zh: 渲染挂死时由进程组看门狗杀掉并继续下一个曲风；配可红判据：喂永不回答的子进程，1.5 秒被杀且下一任务照跑。
highlights.en: A wedged render is killed by a process-group watchdog and the batch carries on, with a criterion that feeds it a child which never answers.

title.zh: 手机端可读性与样式归属的小修
title.en: Small fixes for phone readability and style ownership

highlights.zh: 手机最暗的一层文字调亮：对底色从 3.95:1 提到 5.24:1，越过正文门槛。
highlights.en: The dimmest phone text is lighter: 3.95:1 became 5.24:1 on the page, clearing the body-text floor.

highlights.zh: 和弦页三处写死的灰改用本皮肤墨色；App 里手机壳的懒加载移到其它视图旁边。
highlights.en: Three hardcoded greys in the chords view use the skin's own ink, and the phone shell's lazy import sits with the other views in App.

title.zh: 手机版以 /m 子路径回来，并带上预生成的主题片段
title.en: The phone version returns at /m, with pre-cut theme clips

highlights.zh: 手机壳 40 个文件接回：/m 路由、皮肤独立样式域、44px 与对比度三组判据、换音源可试听。
highlights.en: Forty phone-shell files are back: the /m route, an independent skin domain, the 44 px and contrast criteria, and an audition in the instrument chooser.

highlights.zh: 155 个 15–30 秒片段，各用该曲风自己的音色，存 Cloudflare；生成时同时体检数据并把问题写进清单。
highlights.en: 155 clips of 15–30 s, each through its genre's own instruments and served from Cloudflare; generation audits the genre data and writes what it finds into the list.

highlights.zh: 导出不再沉默六秒：先说“正在准备乐器…”，首次反馈从 6.4 秒缩到 0.1 秒。
highlights.en: An export no longer begins with six silent seconds: it says "Preparing instruments…", moving first feedback from 6.4 s to 0.1 s.
